name: تحدي الكلمات
description: Arabic anagram word game for TikTok LIVE — viewers guess words from scrambled letters; gifts trigger power-ups.

effects.reveal_letter: reveal one letter of a remaining word
effects.length_hint: show remaining word lengths + first letters
effects.extra_points: award bonus points to the gifter
effects.hint_all: reveal the shape of every remaining word (reserved)
